body.p: A wolf came to a bear. It came and asked: "What are you afraid of?" "Of the hazel grouse", the bear said. "What are you afraid of?" "I am afraid of humans." The bear said: "Eh, you are afraid of the humans, I'm not afraid." "Let's search for a human, you just bring a human, I'll bring hazel grouses", the wolf said. The wolf brought a pit full [of hazel grouses], it couldn't wait for the bear. The wolf couldn't wait and went to search for the bear. It found the bear, having died. Two humans had killed [it], younger brothers of the human. The wolf said: "You didn't bring [anything], you didn't bring a single one." The bear said: "It was seven people, part of them ran away, two younger brothers are not wounded, I couldn't kill them(?), two younger brothers.[DCh]: The whole sentence is not really clear; neither is it clear why the bear is alive again. Since then and further on nothing shall sound." The bear said: "Let's separate." The bear went off and met a chipmunk. It said to the chipmunk: "Bring berries, for I can eat them. If you bring berries, I won't eat anything [other] in future." The chipmunk said: "What do you give?" "What do I give, I'll paint your fur." The chipmunk brought some berries. When it had brought them, the bear said: "Well, I'll caress [you] with my paw." So the chipmunk's fur got painted. Then the bear went off, it met the fox. The fox said: "Eh, grandfather, let's sleep!" "For sleeping", the bear said, "there is a cliff where there are no mosquitos." There they fell asleep. The bear had very much wanted to sleep. As soon as it [=the bear] was sleeping, the fox went to the peak. "Oh, grandfather, I'd like to roll down, come up!" The bear moved upwards, rolled down and fell. Having fallen, it lives all the time on the ground. Earlier it lived up there.
